sources.title: Gangplank Top (2026), Crit GP Deep Dive

passive.name: Trial by Fire
passive.text: Every few seconds, Gangplank's melee strike will set his opponent on fire.

spells.name: Parrrley
spells.text: Shoots target, plundering Gold for each enemy unit killed.

spells.name: Remove Scurvy
spells.text: Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health.

spells.name: Powder Keg
spells.text: Gangplank uncovers a powder keg at target location. If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area, slowing them.

spells.name: Cannon Barrage
spells.text: Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area, slowing and damaging enemies.

damage.value: Gangplank deals physical burst damage with crit builds and can one-shot enemies at four or more items.

archetype.value: Gangplank is a crit carry who zones fights, cleans up, and provides ultimate utility rather than frontlining.

axis.value: Gangplank uses barrels to control lane, takes favorable trades, and freezes whenever possible instead of fast-pushing into an enemy.

winCondition.value: Gangplank wins by zoning and cleaning up teamfights, then securing objectives.

spikes.why: Gangplank gains a lane power spike that supports snowballing.
Gangplank shifts toward grouping for teamfights and objectives.

spikes.at: Remove Scurvy’s cooldown falls from 22 to 14 seconds
spikes.why: Gangplank can cure crowd control and restore Health more often.

bait.why: When Gangplank spends his barrels, he loses the barrel zone that supports his trades and wave control.

mistakes.value: Gangplank players make a mistake when they frontline instead of zoning and cleaning up.
Gangplank misses Powder Keg’s area damage and slow if he does not attack the keg.
